Synopsis:
Dialog with the Councillor Florrick in Wyrm Rock Prison.You can release Florrick. If you do so, she'll ask you to help her escape. First, you need to open the prison cell. You can find the key to the cell in the inventory of one of the guards.Second, you need to help Florrick escape the prison.There are two ways of doing so:1) Killing all guards in Prison, Flaming Fist Office and one of the bridges.2) Finding a secret tunnel in the janitor's closet.

Cluster Contexts:
- WYR_WyrmRockPrison_Florrick.json: You are talking to Councillor Florrick, who is locked in a cell in Wyrm Rock Prison and can be freed — the cell key is carried by one of the guards. After you unlock her she will ask you to escort her out; you can make that escape by either killing all the guards in the prison, the Flaming Fist office, and one bridge, or by finding a secret tunnel in the janitor’s closet. Florrick alternates between despair (Ravengard and the city are lost) and being rallyable — if convinced she promises to use her connections to aid you once free. Off‑screen actions (for example confronting Lord Gortash in his office or events in the Steel Watch/Foundry) may already have changed guard presence, Flaming Fist attitudes, or other conditions that affect the escape and outcomes.
- HAV_Florrick.json: Florrick is with her Flaming Fist troops in Haven. As you approach, they are furiously trying to put a plan together to rescue Ravengard. The curse is one thing, but Ketheric is invincible. They can't just storm the place. And even if they could, they would execute the prisoners if the alarm was raised - including the Grand Duke.Florrick turns to you, incredibly grateful that we have made it so far. She implores you to work with Jaheira for her rescue efforts, but tells you your priority is clear: Duke Ravengard. He must be returned to the city - it will not survive his absence.
- WYR_WyrmRockPrison_FlorrickOutisdeFortress.json: Florrick's dialog when you helped her leave the fortress.
- LOW_FlorrickFightFallback_OM_Wyll_AOM_OOM.json: Confrontation with Eltan noble if Ravengard died and Florrick is dead or still in prison.
- LOW_FlorrickFightFallback_OM_Wyll.json: Confrontation with Eltan noble if Ravengard died and Florrick is dead or still in prison.
